messages:
morgan: Quick ask — can we secure a small H100 slot in apac (asia-southeast1) next Wed 09:00-12:00 UTC for a customer canary? Need 1 node (80GB) for ~3 hours. cc @gleb-vendor. Also will need a brief terraform PR + smoke window. What is lead time and ballpark cost?

gleb-vendor: We do have very limited H100 capacity in asia-southeast1 that week. I can put 1 node in standby/reserve for you but need billing sign-off. Ballpark: ~ $180/hr for a dedicated node (before discounts). If you can provide project id + billing owner I can start the reserve.

sam: To add — if you want a dedicated standby we'll need a quota bump on the project: redwood-canary-apac. @jess-finance will need to approve cost and we need a terraform change to create the pool allocation (small snippet below).

```hcl
resource "redwood_gpu_pool" "canary_apac_h100" {
  region = "asia-southeast1"
  sku = "h100-80gb"
  min_nodes = 1
  max_nodes = 1
  purpose = "customer-canary-2026-03"
}
```

anya: I can open the infra PR today with that config and a small job to run the canary workload. Will tag riley-oncall for the smoke. PR draft: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/1234 (will switch to real when ready).

riley-oncall: I can own the oncall window. Suggest we do a quick staging smoke at 03:00 UTC the same day to validate networking and KV cache warming before the customer run at 09:00. Also let's enable verbose logging for the first 10 minutes.

gleb-vendor: Sounds good — I'll hold the slot provisionally for 24h pending billing. Ping me when finance confirms and when the PR is merged so we can attach the tenant to the allocation.

jess-finance: Provisional OK up to $600 for the run. Need exact estimate and project code to finalize chargeback. Please include expected token throughput if you want a more precise cost projection.

morgan: Thanks — will send exact estimate and token throughput by EOD today. Project: redwood-canary-apac. I'll merge the PR after anya's finalizes and will paste the PR link here. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: terraform plan for redwood-canary-apac succeeded in CI (job 9876). Plan shows +1 gpu pool resource pending apply.

anya: PR updated, added smoke job and logging flags. Ready for review — tagging @sam @riley-oncall.

sam: LGTM, please include a short rollback playbook in the PR description (how to drain and fall back to hosted model variant).

morgan: Will add rollback steps and then merge once finance confirms final number. Thanks everyone!
